summary: WF-03 Step 1 root-cause diagnosis of ISS-0709 / GH #799 (VLD-01/02/03 semantic validation in-file test failures). Read the handoff, the issue record, the TEST-RUNNER report §1/§3.1 and all src/validation/*.zig sources; confirmed every hypothesis by running `zig build test-validation` (32/38 passed, 4 failed, 2 crashed, 11 leaks). The 10 failing tests collapse into 5 root causes: R1 freeSites leaks the []Site backing from enumerateSites' toOwnedSlice (3 site tests + pd06 malformed test — pure leak panics, logic correct); R2 TypedEnv.deinit double-frees a borrowed ArrayList backing in the typecheck tests ('Invalid free' panic); R3 env.zig mapDeclaredTypeName('number') returns null -> spurious UnknownVariableType + variable absent from env -> clean-path 'expected 0, found 3' and unknown-var no-suggestion failures; R4 PD-06 gate under-detection (isValidCelSyntax delimiter-only accepts dangling operators) plus env findings accumulated before the gate -> VLD-02 AC4 short-circuit unreachable (malformed-guard + ordering tests); R5 mod.zig per-site loop leaks the []Finding backing from checkSite's toOwnedSlice (secondary leak). Analysis written into docs/issues/ISS-0709.json (root_cause_analysis: 10 per-test entries, 5 grouped root causes, fix_scope, one design decision flagged for R3). DIAGNOSIS ONLY — no src/*.zig file modified.
